Zoho is built for every business. RetailerOS is built for electronics retail.

Zoho Books is cloud accounting with GST filing, and Zoho Inventory manages stock and orders; they share one account, and Zoho POS handles counter billing. Where each one is strong

Where Zoho Books & Inventory is strong

  • Compliance-grade cloud accounting: GSTR-1 filed to the portal, e-invoicing, P&L and balance sheet
  • A genuinely free Books plan for businesses under ₹25 lakh a year
  • Strong online selling: Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce and 40+ couriers
  • Books, Inventory, POS, CRM and more in one Zoho account

Where RetailerOS goes further

  • One product for the whole electronics counter, instead of three to set up and connect
  • IMEI and serial tracking on every paid plan
  • Brand schemes tracked against targets, with claims from the sales that earned them
  • Repair and service job cards, from intake to handover
  • Pre-booking for launches and WhatsApp follow-up sequences built in
  • Priced per store, with 3 staff logins included in each

Which should you choose?

Choose Zoho if

You sell a wide mix online and offline, need full cloud accounting, and do not deal in brand schemes or repairs.

Choose RetailerOS if

You run a phone, appliance or electronics counter and want schemes, repairs and IMEI history in one system.

Keep Zoho Books for the books

Some retailers keep their accounts in Zoho Books and run the counter on RetailerOS.

Questions

Does Zoho track IMEI numbers?

Yes, as serial number tracking: in Zoho Inventory from the Premium plan (₹2,299 a month, billed yearly), in Zoho Books from the Elite plan (₹4,999), and in Zoho POS from Standard (₹649 per location). Prices from zoho.com/in, checked 28 September 2026, excluding GST.

Does Zoho handle brand schemes or repairs?

Brand scheme claims and repair job cards are not listed on Zoho Books, Inventory or POS pages. RetailerOS includes both.

How much does Zoho cost?

Zoho Books runs from free (under ₹25 lakh revenue) to ₹7,999 a month; Zoho Inventory from free to ₹7,499; Zoho POS from free to ₹2,099 per location — billed yearly, excluding GST. A retail counter usually needs two of them.

Can I keep Zoho Books for accounts?

Yes. Many retailers keep their accountant on their existing books and run the counter on RetailerOS.
